description: Codex: Orks (11e) Da Big Hunt — DA HUNT IS ON (WP-O34): Beast Snagga units' attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 AP. Fixture ork11e_o34_hunt: the Custodes' Contemptor-Achillus Dreadnought (VEHICLE) is engaged with the Beast Snagga Boyz. Setup (Charge phase, which then ends): detachment Da Big Hunt; the Allarus Custodians step back so the Dreadnought stands alone in front of the Beast Snagga's front rank; Custodes CP 0. Fight phase: Pile In passed, the Beast Snagga Boyz are clicked and all attacks go to the Dreadnought: the dice log's melee save roll shows the weapon's AP improved by 1.

steps.comment: setup privilege: the fixture's Ork detachment is switched to Da Big Hunt (stratagems + detachment rules reloaded)
the Dreadnought is the only enemy in engagement range
a melee save roll at the weapon's AP improved by 1 (vs the VEHICLE)
